annotations.title: Buy a phone number at once

description:
COSTS MONEY: Buy a phone number at once

Buys a number from `GET /phone-numbers/instant` and pays the first month plus VAT from your balance, like the instant buy on the billing page. The number joins your account at once; assign it to an agent afterwards.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.
